_comment: Committed content for the adequacy family (B-13 P2, JB-4) — the judge-tier proxy: request + response, label = all(constraints executed) over drawn facts (value correct, response within the explicit format constraint). Operations and operands are drawn; responses are rendered from the same drawn values, so the text always matches the facts.
question: Is the response a complete and compliant answer to the request?

criteria.false: Wrong, incomplete, or violates an explicit constraint of the request
criteria.true: Correct, complete, and within every explicit constraint

requests.template: Request: Compute the sum of {a} and {b}. Return only the number.
Request: Compute {a} minus {b}. Return only the number.
Request: Compute {a} times {b}. Return only the number, no commentary.
Request: Give the sum of {a} and {b} and the value of {a} minus {b}, one per line, in that order.
Request: Count the words in the quote "{quote}". Return only the number.
Request: Round {decimal} to one decimal place. Return only the number.

quotes: delayed trains ran on the branching line
the northern gate stays closed at night
fresh stock reaches the shelf at dawn
late shifts cover the eastern platform

prose.false: Let me work through it first: the result comes out to {wrong}.

style_violation_note: The response adds commentary the request forbids.
